messages:
elena: Quick sync — need to lock down observability scope for the console release next sprint. Customer-Alpha is pushing hard for per-model cost breakdown + error grouping by API route. We have three tradeoff paths: A) full dashboards + tracing hooks (higher dev+infra cost), B) lightweight cost widget + sampled traces, C) cost-only MVP with later tracing expansion. Which one keeps SLAs doable and still appeases the customer?

ben: My vote is B. We can surface cost behind a single panel quickly and enable sampling for traces. Full tracing hooks require infra changes (span enrichment + extra retention) and will blow the ops budget.

parul: Agree B pragmatically. Also we should scope what "sampled traces" means — 1% global sampling won't help for low-volume enterprise customers; need route-targeted sampling and on-demand tail snapshots.

chris: +1 for B with targeted sampling. Implementation notes: we can add a trace selector that uses route + model-id as keys. Sampling config idea:

```
# sampling.json (proposal)
{
  "default_rate": 0.01,
  "route_overrides": {
    "/v1/generate": 0.05,
    "/v1/stream": 0.02
  },
  "customer_overrides": {
    "customer-alpha": 0.25
  }
}
```

That keeps volume down but surfaces customer issues.

tara: If we go B, acceptance criteria must include: cost tile showing per-model cost for last 7d, error-rate by route with 95th latency, and a UI flow to request a full trace capture for a selected request id. Customer wants SLOs tied to routes too.

elena: Good call. Let's draft launch criteria (MUST):
- Cost breakdown tile: per-model, per-route (7d, 30d) and export CSV.
- Error analytics: grouped by route + top 3 stack traces, ability to pivot by model-id.
- Trace sampling: route-targeted sampling with customer override; on-demand snapshot (capture full trace for a single request).
- Rollout: staged to 10% customers -> 50% -> 100% with canary rollback.

ben: Ops/infra asks: we need to budget for ~15% storage bump in traces for targeted sampling and for the on-demand capture window. Also we need a short retention policy doc to avoid surprises.

parul: One more thing — accuracy for "per-model cost" can be done by attributing GPU-time buckets, but quantized rounding will confuse sales/finance. We should include a caveat in the UI: "estimated cost" + link to raw usage export.

chris: UX note: the error grouping should include a simple regex-sanitizer for stack traces so PII doesn't leak. We can reuse sanitize pipeline from runtime-telemetry.

elena: Prioritization decision: for launch we will target path B (lightweight cost widget + sampled traces) but with two stretch items to include post-launch if we hit perf/cost targets within 2 weeks: 1) add span-level latency heatmap; 2) automated anomaly alerts for cost spikes.

tara: Customers to notify: Customer-Alpha, Beta-Research (they requested SLO per-route), and internal platform-team. @chris can you own the sampling config? @ben can you confirm infra budget?

chris: I can own sampling config + selector. Will post PR with config + test harness by EOW.

ben: I'll validate budget estimates with infra and reply by EOD tomorrow. If infra says no, we drop on-demand snapshot and make it an enterprise-only flag.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window: 2026-04-05T18:00Z -> 2026-04-05T20:00Z. Notify #eng-oncall before promote.

parul: Small implementation question — on-demand snapshot: do we surface it in the console as a button that triggers a retention-time-lift for a single request id? That seems easiest from a UX + infra perspective.

elena: Yes — UI button that triggers a one-off retention override + immediate trace capture. Ensure we have a TTL (1 hour) and an audit log entry.

chris: Will add TTL enforcement in the apiservice layer. Also adding audit log hook.

tara: For launch comms — we need release notes, a migration doc for customers that relied on old cost page, and a short demo. I'll take release notes + demo deck.

elena: Action items summarized:
- chris: sampling config + PR (owner)
- ben: infra budget confirmation + retention plan (owner)
- parul: data caveat copy + PII sanitizer checklist (owner)
- tara: release notes + demo (owner)
- elena: coordinate canary windows + customer comms (owner)

ben: +1. If infra gives green, plan B -> ship next sprint. If infra says no, propose alternate scoping: remove on-demand snapshot and increase sampling rate for specific customers.

elena: Cool. If nobody objects I'll convert this into a short RFC and a milestone in the roadmap board. Please comment if you see any blockers by EOD. :thumbsup:

parul: No blockers from my side. :eyes:

chris: No blockers. Starting config PR today.

tara: I'll draft comms.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion reminder will ping #release-war-room 1h before window.
